description: Every allowed non-PASSED result of the conformance plans, with its reason. run-plans.py fails on any result that isn't listed here, and on listed results that no longer happen. WARNING entries list the allowed warning conditions; any other warning fails the run. See docs/conformance/results.md.

results.reason: ValkyrieID stores only some profile claims (name, given_name, family_name, preferred_username, updated_at); the others (e.g. birthdate, gender, picture) are never returned. OIDC Core §5.4 only asks for claims that are available.

The claims of the profile and email scopes are also put in the ID token, for clients that only read the ID token (ASP.NET Core AddOpenIdConnect by default, oauth2-proxy, Grafana). OIDC Core §5.4 returns them from UserInfo when an access token is issued; not a MUST.
Same as oidcc-scope-email: scope claims are also in the ID token.
ValkyrieID defines no authentication context classes and reports the methods used in amr (RFC 8176). acr_values requests acr as a voluntary claim (OIDC Core §3.1.2.1), and acr is OPTIONAL (§2).

On authorization code reuse the refresh tokens issued from the code are revoked, but the self-contained access token stays valid until it expires. Approved deviation from RFC 6749 §4.1.2 (PROJECT.md, Spec deviations).
The claims request parameter isn't supported (claims_parameter_supported is false in discovery), so name isn't returned without the profile scope.

Form Post Basic only (release tags). The suite sends response_mode=form_post and state only inside the request object. Request objects aren't supported, so ValkyrieID answers request_not_supported (OIDC Core §6.1) with the default query response mode: it doesn't read response_mode from the unsupported, unverified request object. The same test is SKIPPED in Basic OP, where the response mode is the default. Approved 2026-11-07.
